annotations.title: Choose which alerts a channel receives

description: Choose which event groups one alert channel receives. provider: slack, discord or webhook. events: any of renders (a render finished or failed), posts (a scheduled post published, partly published or failed), approvals (autopilot drafts waiting for review), watch (new competitor ads found by the competitor watch), credits (credits running low), leads (a new lead-form lead from Meta, LinkedIn or Snapchat), connections (an account connected to or disconnected from the brand: account.connected / account.disconnected), inbox (a new Facebook or Instagram comment or direct message: comment.received / message.received; opt-in, never on unless named) — or "all". An empty list keeps the channel connected and sends it nothing. Unknown names are refused by name. Read back from the stored setting. Free.

provider.description: alert channel to configure: slack, discord or webhook
